rubric_name: Introduction to RAG - Beginner Lesson Quality Rubric

target_learner.prior_knowledge: assume zero knowledge of RAG and related AI concepts

checks.name: Accuracy
checks.description: The lesson must contain technically correct explanations of RAG and must not include misleading or false claims.
checks.pass_condition: Every important technical claim about RAG is correct.

checks.name: Beginner Friendly
checks.description: The lesson must be understandable to the target learner using simple and clear English.
checks.pass_condition: The lesson explains ideas in simple language without assuming prior AI knowledge.

checks.name: Key Concepts
checks.description: The lesson must explain what RAG is, why it matters, and the basic way it works.
checks.pass_condition: What, why, and how of RAG are clearly covered.

checks.name: Example
checks.description: The lesson must teach the idea using at least one simple practical example.
checks.pass_condition: At least one example clearly shows how RAG can be useful.

checks.name: Jargon Control
checks.description: Important technical terms must be explained in simple language before or when they are used.
checks.pass_condition: A beginner can understand important technical terms from the lesson itself.

checks.name: Teaching Flow
checks.description: The lesson must follow a logical teaching sequence from basic ideas to more detailed ideas.
checks.pass_condition: The lesson has a clear and coherent progression.

checks.name: Grounding
checks.description: The lesson must stay consistent with the knowledge available to the generation and evaluation system.
checks.pass_condition: Important factual claims can be supported by the available knowledge context.
